:::{#def-answer}
#### Answer

For a [question](#def-question) about $X$,
write $a(x)$ for the [possible answer](#def-possible-answer) that holds the value $x$.
The **answer** to the question is the [random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable)

$$A \eqdef a(X).$$

:::
